final: WITH per_station AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS overall_avg FROM per_station), qualifying AS (SELECT p.observstation, p.avg_bandusage, p.avg_bandusage - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM per_station AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_bandusage > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage), AVG(diff) FROM qualifying
